content: In this paper, we apply pre-trained representations from language models to language generation tasks that can be modeled by sequence to sequence architectures. Previous work on integrating language models with sequence to sequence models focused on the decoder network and added language model representations right before the output of the decoder BIBREF6 . We extend their study by investigating several other strategies such as inputting ELMo-style representations BIBREF0 or fine-tuning the language model (§ SECREF2 ).
